summary: Fail closed for unverified item category and price writes; keep categories, stores, and filters read-only.
reason: The protobuf schema carries item category assignments, store IDs, and PBItemPrice values, but the current verified client surface has no read-after-write-verified handlers for per-item price or store assignment. Item category updates were already rejected after an acknowledged operation failed to round-trip. A fresh disposable re-probe could not be run because the stored AnyList credential returned HTTP 401 before a marker list was created; no live data was changed. Do not let items add report success for category or price metadata that may be silently ignored.
validated_outcome: Non-dry-run items add now returns an explicit unsupported error before any request when category or price metadata is supplied, while dry-run remains offline. Categories and stores/filters remain read-only. Focused unit tests cover category, price, price-store, price-details, and dry-run paths. No disposable marker list or item was created because the re-probe was rejected at authentication.
